scope: beat-upstream 14-day screen, first run with the repaired feed path

version_gate.note: Two gate bugs were fixed after the run and the survivor list re-scored. Records often put the whole affected range in the version field as '< 2.0.5' rather than filling lessThan, which the parser read as an introduced version; and the tag-lag gate only inspected tags newer than the packaged version, so a tree already carrying the fix looked like an opportunity. PrivateBin CVE-2026-55891 reached the shortlist through both: nixpkgs packages 2.0.6 and the fix shipped in 2.0.5.

note: Compare with beat-upstream-summary-2026-09-01.json: 0 survivors of 6297, which was feed data loss rather than absence of opportunity. The version gate landed after this run, so the 76 out-of-range rejects were computed by re-scoring the survivor list; a future run applies the gate inline. Survivors are candidates, not verified patches: each still has to pass Patcher, Reviewer, a discriminating reproducer and cert.
